creator: Reubin Clein
Ben F. Drucker
subject: Florida Power & Light Company

Parks and recreation planning
Florida oil development
fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on Miami and Florida politics and civic affairs, including advocacy for state/public ownership of Florida Power & Light and other utilities; criticism of Miami police leadership and the handling of the Lieut. C. O. Huttoe case and related grand jury matters; commentary on state budget/tax debates and press positions; and assorted local items such as federal restrictions on refilling sleeping-pill prescriptions, parks and playground expansion plans, and notes on Florida oil development. Also contains letters to the editor, columns, and advertisements.
